title: Ten days in Japan by rail: Tokyo, a night in Hakone, Kyoto, Osaka
variant: One vertical spine with a node per day and train legs as rows
prompt: Ten days in Japan by rail, first time, Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, with one onsen night.
note: One vertical spine down the page with a node per day, a larger brand-colored marker at each city change, and the four train legs as thin mono rows carrying the operator, the duration, and a reserve-the-seat tag, because a rail trip is a sequence and the reader wants to see where the legs fall before reading any day. Dense on purpose, with a label column for morning, afternoon, and evening inside each day, no photos, and the places list in two columns so ten days fit in a page a traveler can scroll on a platform.
